name: Gustave Caillebotte

summary.text: Gustave Caillebotte was a French painter who was a member and patron of the Impressionists, although he painted in a more realistic manner than many others in the group. Caillebotte was known for his early interest in photography as an art form.
summary.title: Gustave Caillebotte

1452762: Paris Street; Rainy Day is a large 1877 oil painting by the French artist Gustave Caillebotte, now at the Art Institute of Chicago in Chicago, Illinois.
1766454: Les raboteurs de parquet is an oil painting by French Impressionist Gustave Caillebotte. The canvas measures 102 by 146.5 centimetres.
1857132: Vue de toits (Effet de neige) (English title: View of rooftops (Effect of snow)) is an oil painting executed during the winter of 1878 and 1879 by French impressionist Gustave Caillebotte. The canvas measures 81 by 65 centimetres (32 in × 26 in).
2335560: Le Pont de l'Europe is an oil painting by French impressionist Gustave Caillebotte completed in 1876. It is held by the Musée du Petit Palais in Geneva, Switzerland.
4067988: Les Orangers is an oil painting by French impressionist Gustave Caillebotte. The canvas measures 155 by 117 centimetres.
8058274: Young Man at His Window is an 1876 painting by the French Impressionist Gustave Caillebotte (1848–1894). The oil on canvas painting measures 117 by 82 centimetres.
16837275: A Balcony in Paris is an oil-on-canvas painting executed c. 1880–1881 by the French Impressionist painter Gustave Caillebotte. The dimensions of the painting are 55.2 by 39 centimeters.
16995784: Homme au bain is an 1884 oil painting by French Impressionist Gustave Caillebotte.
28110217: The Bezique Game is an 1880 oil-on-canvas painting by the French impressionist artist Gustave Caillebotte (1848–1894). The work is now in the collection of the Louvre Abu Dhabi.
28110219: Boating Party, also known as The Boating Party or Oarsman In A Top Hat, is an oil painting by the French painter Gustave Caillebotte.
28494210: The Portrait of Richard Gallo is an oil-on-canvas painting by French painter Gustave Caillebotte in the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City, Missouri.
62700218: Skiffsα, also known as Boating on the Yerres, is an oil painting by French impressionist and realist painter Gustave Caillebotte, completed in 1877.
